payload.reason: The evidence provides specific performance results related to the detection of cyberbullying across different datasets and models.

claims.text: Oversampled datasets (F+, T+, W+) show significantly better performance compared to their non-oversampled counterparts (F, T, W).

Using TL1, the cyberbullying detection performance for the Formspring dataset is higher with Wikipedia as the base model (precision=0.51, recall=0.66) compared to Twitter (precision=0.38, recall=0.04).
Recall scores improved dramatically with TL2 compared to TL1, indicating significant performance enhancement.
Improvements in precision were also significant with TL2, highlighting the effectiveness of learned word embeddings in knowledge transfer for cyberbullying detection.
